title: SolQvia -> Luqevora cross-brand revenue attribution
privacy_rule: No user-specific identifier is generated. bridge_id is deterministic from the SolQvia article identifier, route id and route group.

query_parameters.sq_bridge: Deterministic bridge ID such as sqb_1a2b3c4d

a8_attribution.mechanism: On Luqevora, if a session originated from SolQvia, A8.net links are enriched at click time with id5=<existingReleasePrefix><bridgeToken>.
a8_attribution.bridge_token: bridge_id with non-alphanumeric characters removed; ASCII alphanumeric only
a8_attribution.privacy: No personal information is placed in A8 parameters.
a8_attribution.normal_luqevora_sessions: No A8 link rewrite is performed when the session did not originate from SolQvia.
